purpose: Paired TUN-proxy A/B of PR #70 extra per-pump poll_read_ready on continuously-ready bulk and mixed RR. Reuses unmodified bench/pareto/issue23_tun_case.py and issue23_tun_load.py. Not qa-perf.yml and not a calibrated production gate.

protocol.smoke: one candidate run with rr_samples=100 and bulk_bytes_per_flow=1048576; diagnostic; excluded from statistics
protocol.ab_order_rule: pair i uses AB if i even else BA; positions 0 then 1; no replacement of failed slots
protocol.cpu_metric: whole proxy process utime+stime from /proc ticks during bulk windows (issue23 Observer), not harness/system CPU
protocol.goodput_metric: verified application bytes / bulk wall from issue23_tun_load bulk records
p99_metrics: mixed RR RTT for exchanges started during bulk (n>=100 required for p99)
standalone RR p99 for size 64 in phase 1
protocol.fairness_metric: Jain index of per-flow verified_bytes/wall within each bulk window; equal bytes are required by the loader

inference.method: paired median percent change with descriptive bootstrap 95% interval when n>=6; no multiple-comparison correction; no registered non-inferiority budget
inference.aa_use: noise floor only; if A/B interval is inside A/A noise, result is INCONCLUSIVE
inference.qualification: isolated Cloud Agent VM TUN diagnostic. Not physical-domain exclusive, not cgroup-certified, not WireGuard, not qa-perf.yml. Cannot establish production PASS.
